name: amplemarket
longDescription: Ask your chats to find people and companies, enrich a lead and start the right sequence from one prompt.

actions.label: Search Amplemarket people
actions.description: Finds people matching the job title, company or seniority you describe.

actions.label: Search Amplemarket companies
actions.description: Finds companies matching the size, industry or location you describe.

actions.label: Enrich an Amplemarket contact
actions.description: Fills in what Amplemarket knows about one person from their email or profile.

actions.label: List Amplemarket sequences
actions.description: Lists the outreach sequences in your account.

actions.label: Add leads to a sequence
actions.description: Puts the leads you supply into one Amplemarket sequence.
